blurb: East Potomac Golf Links has two 9-hole courses (Red and White), one 18-hole course (Blue), a driving range, miniature golf, foot golf, and practice holes. The White Course is a 9-hole, par 34 executive course suitable for intermediate golfers and also serves as an 18-hole FootGolf course. The Blue Course is an 18-hole, par 72 course with views of Washington landmarks.
